entities.name: Varangian Trade Routes
entities.label: EventWindow
entities.summary: Varangian (Norse) traders established routes 'from the Varangians to the Greeks' (Dnieper) and to the Islamic world (Volga). The founding of Ladoga and Novgorod as trading centres, and the legendary 'calling of the Varangians' (862).
